summary: Full-extraction pass over six stored Swiss documents on lump-sum (expenditure-based) taxation and the fiscal-interest residence permit: the 2011 Federal Council message, the 2019 FDK cantonal survey, three DBG consolidations and the VZAE. Added 456 observations (cantonal counts and revenue from the FDK survey, ESTV 2007 cantonal statistics and reform scenarios, economic-impact estimates), 9 terms, 13 events and 4 proposed indicators.

events.title: Vaud is the first canton to offer expenditure-based taxation to non-working foreigners
events.description: The Federal Council message says the canton of Vaud was in 1862 the first canton to offer non-working foreign nationals a special form of taxation, for tourism and economic reasons. Cantonal origin of the regime; other cantons and the federation followed later.
events.quote: 1862 hat der Kanton Waadt als erster Kanton aufgrund von touristischen und wirtschaftlichen Interessen nichterwerbstätigen Ausländerinnen und Ausländern eine besondere Besteuerungsart angeboten.

events.title: Geneva introduces lump-sum taxation
events.description: Geneva has had expenditure-based taxation since 1928 (Federal Council message, citing Bernasconi 1983).

events.title: Federal level introduces lump-sum taxation
events.description: The federation has applied expenditure-based taxation since 1934 (Federal Council message).

events.title: Intercantonal concordat sets common rules for lump-sum taxation
events.description: On 10 Dec 1948 the cantons concluded the intercantonal concordat on the exclusion of tax agreements, agreeing uniform rules for lump-sum taxation; the federation followed almost a year later and most cantons then introduced provisions. The message calls it the "birth" of lump-sum taxation.
events.quote: Die «Geburtsstunde» der Aufwandbesteuerung war jedoch der 10. Dezember 1948

events.title: Lump-sum taxation written into the federal tax acts (DBG and StHG)
events.description: On 14 Dec 1990 expenditure-based taxation was anchored in the Federal Act on Direct Federal Tax (art. 14 DBG) and the Tax Harmonisation Act (art. 6 StHG).
events.quote: Am 14. Dezember 1990 wurde schliesslich die Aufwandbesteuerung im Bundesgesetz über die direkte Bundessteuer

events.title: Cantonal finance directors recommend a five-times-rent floor
events.description: The FDK recommended to the cantons in 2007 to use five times the rental value as the lowest base, as at federal level, plus a control calculation on Swiss gross income.
events.quote: 2007 erliess sie Empfehlungen an die Kantone, wonach als unterste Grenze für die Festlegung der Aufwandbesteuerung analog der Bundesregelung auf den fünffachen Mietwert abzustellen

events.title: Zurich voters abolish lump-sum taxation
events.description: A popular initiative to abolish expenditure-based taxation was accepted in the canton of Zurich on 7 Feb 2009.
events.quote: Im Kanton Zürich ist am 7. Februar 2009 eine Volksinitiative zur Abschaffung der Besteuerung nach dem Aufwand angenommen worden.

events.title: Zurich abolition of cantonal lump-sum taxation takes effect
events.description: Zurich abolished cantonal lump-sum taxation as of 1 Jan 2010 (footnote 2 and note 1 to Table 1). Footnote 12 of the same message gives 1 Dec 2010 instead; 1 Jan 2010 is used as stated twice. Federal lump-sum taxation remained available to Zurich residents.
events.location: PDF p. 4 (BBl p. 6024), footnote 2; PDF p. 21, note 1 to Tabelle 1
events.quote: Im Kanton Zürich wurde die Besteuerung nach dem Aufwand auf den 1.1.2010 abgeschafft.

events.title: Glarus Landsgemeinde rejects abolition
events.description: The Landsgemeinde of the canton of Glarus rejected abolition of lump-sum taxation on 1 May 2011.
events.quote: Im Kanton Glarus wurde die Abschaffung der Aufwandbesteuerung in der Landsgemeinde vom 1. Mai 2011 abgelehnt.

events.title: Thurgau rejects abolition but tightens its minimums
events.description: Thurgau voters rejected abolition on 15 May 2011 but accepted a government counter-proposal: a minimum tax of CHF 150,000 or, if higher, ten times the rent or imputed rent, or four times board costs, as the base.
events.quote: Im Kanton Thurgau lehnten die Stimmbürger und Stimmbürgerinnen die Abschaffung der Aufwandbesteuerung am 15. Mai 2011 ab

events.title: Federal Council proposes reform of lump-sum taxation
events.description: Message to Parliament proposing worldwide expenditure as the base, a federal minimum base of CHF 400,000 (indexed), at least seven times rent or three times board, cantonal minimums, both spouses to qualify, no lump-sum taxation for Swiss nationals in the arrival year, explicit wealth tax in cantons, and a five-year transition for existing cases. Adopted by Parliament on 28 Sep 2012, in force 1 Jan 2016 (see DBG).
events.quote: Botschaft zum Bundesgesetz über die Besteuerung nach dem Aufwand vom 29. Juni 2011

events.title: Federal minimum lump-sum tax base indexed to CHF 421,700
events.description: The EFD ordinance of 16 Sep 2022 on cold progression raised the minimum base for direct federal tax under art. 14(3)(a) DBG from CHF 400,000 to CHF 421,700, in force 1 Jan 2023 (AS 2022 575).
events.quote: Fassung gemäss Art. 5 der V des EFD vom 16. Sept. 2022 über die kalte Progression, in Kraft seit 1. Jan. 2023 (AS 2022 575).

events.title: Federal minimum lump-sum tax base indexed to CHF 435,000
events.description: The EFD ordinance of 10 Sep 2025 on cold progression raised the minimum base for direct federal tax under art. 14(3)(a) DBG to CHF 435,000, in force 1 Jan 2026 (AS 2025 579).
events.quote: Fassung gemäss Art. 3 der V des EFD vom 10. Sept. 2025 über die kalte Progression, in Kraft seit 1. Jan. 2026 (AS 2025 579).

ledger.contains: Federal Council message of 29 Jun 2011 on the federal act on lump-sum taxation (BBl 2011 6021, 26 pp.): history (Vaud 1862, Geneva 1928, federal 1934, concordat 10 Dec 1948, DBG/StHG 14 Dec 1990); law before the reform (5x rent, 2x board, control calculation); fiscal weight (2010 revenue CHF 668m: cantons 300m, federal 204m, communes 165m; 73.9% of taxpayers and 77.8% of cantonal and communal revenue in VD, VS, TI, GE); ESTV estimate of economic effects (CHF 2.3m property per new taxpayer, CHF 0.9bn turnover, 0.6bn and 1.4bn value added, 5,467 + 11,030 + about 6,000 FTE, up to 22,497 jobs; assumes 400 arrivals a year); parliamentary motions; cantonal abolition moves (Zurich vote 7 Feb 2009, abolition 1 Jan 2010 [footnote 12 says 1 Dec 2010], Glarus 1 May 2011, Thurgau 15 May 2011 with CHF 150,000 / 10x rent / 4x board, pending initiatives); FDK recommendations 2007-2010; consultation (58 responses); proposed rules (CHF 400,000 indexed, 7x rent, 3x board, spouses, five-year transition); comparison with UK resident-non-domiciled and Liechtenstein regimes (other countries' regimes, out of scope); Table 1 lump-sum taxpayers, federal revenue 2007 and reform scenarios by canton; Table 2 average taxable income and percentage changes by canton; 80% under CHF 400,000; Zurich 92 of 201 households left by end-2010 (46%). Added 209 observations (Table 1: 19 taxpayer counts, 19 federal revenue figures and 133 scenario values; Table 2: 19 average incomes; 2010 revenue by level; shares, impact estimates, Zurich departures), 5 terms (pre-2016 federal multiples, Thurgau minimums) and 11 events. Not recorded: Table 2 percentage changes, the 45% cantonal share and the 46% Zurich rate (each a printed number divided by another printed number); the assumed 400 arrivals a year (an assumption, in the notes); the proposed rules as such (the enacted versions come from the DBG). Table 1 columns add to the totals within 0.1.

FDK press release of 7 Jun 2019 with annex: lump-sum taxpayers at end-2018 (4,557) and revenue 2018 (CHF 821m); text figures (1,077 fewer since the 2012 peak, 489 or 9.7% fewer since 2016, CHF 54m or 7% more revenue, lowest and highest tax, average CHF 180,162; no data on nationality or migration; five-year transition to 2021); annex table of taxpayers by canton 2008-2018 (with footnotes: earlier-year data, grouped small cantons, estimate); national revenue by level (federal, cantonal, communal) and lowest/highest tax 2008-2018; table by canton for 2018 (count and revenue by level, some cantons with 2017 or 2016 figures). Already in the data: national totals of taxpayers and revenue. Added 247 observations: 132 canton counts incl. the grouped small cantons (each year adds exactly to the national total), 18 revenue rows by level, 13 per-taxpayer rows (lowest, highest, average) under a proposed indicator, 84 canton revenue rows (federal, cantonal, communal, total; periods 2017 or 2016 where the footnotes say so). Not recorded: the 2018 counts in the last table (identical to the 2018 column already taken) and the differences and percentage changes in the text (computed from printed totals). The five abolished cantons are in an existing event.

Federal Act on Direct Federal Tax (DBG), consolidation of 1 Jan 2016, 90 pp. In scope: art. 14 (lump-sum taxation: foreign nationals with first-time or after ten years' absence unlimited tax liability who do not work in Switzerland; both spouses must qualify; base the highest of worldwide living expenses, CHF 400,000, seven times rent or three times board, Swiss-source gross income; ordinary tariff; modified lump-sum for treaty relief; indexation by the EFD) and art. 205d (five-year transition for existing cases). The rest of the act is general income and profit tax law, out of scope. Already in the data: CHF 400,000 term and the 2016 reform event. Added 4 terms (seven times rent, three times board, ten-year absence, five-year transition).

DBG consolidation of 1 Jan 2025, 100 pp.: art. 14 with the minimum base CHF 421,700 (footnote 17: EFD ordinance of 16 Sep 2022, in force 1 Jan 2023), otherwise the same wording as 2016; art. 205d transition. Rest of the act out of scope. Already in the data: the CHF 421,700 term. Added 1 event (indexation in force 1 Jan 2023). Other art. 14 rules are unchanged and recorded from the 2016 consolidation.

DBG consolidation of 2 Sep 2026, 112 pp.: art. 14 with the minimum base CHF 435,000 (footnote 19: EFD ordinance of 10 Sep 2025, in force 1 Jan 2026), otherwise unchanged; art. 205d transition. Rest of the act out of scope. Already in the data: the CHF 435,000 term. Added 1 event (indexation in force 1 Jan 2026).

Ordinance on Admission, Residence and Employment (VZAE), consolidation of 1 Oct 2026, 72 pp. In scope: art. 32 (short-stay or residence permit to protect important public interests, including substantial cantonal fiscal interests, art. 32(1)(c); no amounts, no dates of change). Related but separate: art. 25 on retirees (minimum age 55, no work, means above the supplementary-benefit level), a different admission ground that is not in the programme list. The rest (work permits, family reunion, integration, procedures) is out of scope. No numbers, terms or dated changes for the programme.
